reviews.review_description: installation is not complete but I cant say enough about the company we picked. Just waiting for Ergon to complete their part.

JNT were very quick to respond and provided an onsite quote. The sales rep Ana was super friendly and knew her stuff. She wasn't pushy at all and had the expertise to help us make the best decision. We chose JNT because they are a local business and all their staff live locally too. The install was booked quickly too, and 3.5 weeks later we had our new solar system! The install team were friendly and professional, arrived on time, did a great job and left the area clean and tidy. One thing that impressed me was the messaging system that let me know when they were on their way and approx arrival time every time they they came over, including for the quote.JNT arranged the frid connection and meter upgrade with our energy provider as well, so it was a very smooth process.
The sales team was great at explaining the solar.The Installation guys installed the solar very professionally.When all was completed was shown how to put the app on my phone and how it worked.

Dan at JNT Electrical was very helpful when explaining the various options for us, made it easy to understand the decision we were making.The installation went smoothly with them, they removed the old broken system and cleaned everything up.Grid connection was easy and they stepped me through the use of monitoring app.

The quoting process was simple and straightforward, making it easy to understand the pricing and options available. The team was responsive and transparent, ensuring there were no surprises.The installer was polite and tidy, keeping the workspace clean throughout the process. They arrived on time and completed the installation efficiently, which demonstrated their professionalism and respect for the property.Dan provided excellent customer service, answering every question thoroughly. He helped organize the necessary connections after the installation and took the time to explain how to use the new equipment, making sure we felt confident with the setup.

This was an installation on the roof of a unit,   with much the same layout as a townhouse,  each unit has it's own roof space,  no units above or below.The sales and consultation process was excellent,  Daniel came out and inspected the property,   showed me the app and answered my questions.The ordering process was excellent and the staff processed the order and update to my account and metre with Ergon for me.The team inspect the site and plan the installation the day before,  the team of arrived the next day bright and very early.  After a long day,  the system was fully operational and before long I had the app running on my phone and computer to monitor the output.   The output exceeded my expectations,  on the 2nd day it was a clear sunny day in the middle of July (Winter) when I expected the output to be good,   but it topped out at 5Kws at lunch time which I would not have expected for mid winter,  having had solar panels on my last home for many years.The battery managed to power the unit all night without going flat,  even running an AC in heating mode all night,  since installation the unit has not used more than 1KWh of grid.
Customer service was exceptional from quotes to install and follow up.  Install team were professional and courteous.Team also helped organise everything including the grid connection.

JNT Electrical were everything they promised to be - on time, polite and knowledgeable technicians, great and continuing communication, excellent product and I have the peace of mind to know I can always rely on them to come back and fix any problem. They even offered to replace broken tiles they did not break but found on the roof.
On time,polite and knowledgeable workers. Very helpful and willing to explain things. Prompt communication.Really gr8 interactions with them.

Laurie, who came to quote, was friendly and approachable. He was obviously knowledgeable and had no issue answering all of my questions. He ended up doing 5 quotes for me (different inverter/panel combinations - which involved different configurations of panels too) and nothing was ever a problem. The quote for the exact same system I had everyone quote on was over $600 cheaper. He took the time to explain what he saw as the pros and cons to each of the systems he quoted on also.Installation went smoothly. The team arrived on time and were finished an hour and a half earlier than they had predicted. They confirmed everything Laurie had discussed with me before beginning and on completion gave me a guided tour of everything and helped setup the monitoring from my phone. Laurie also popped in to ensure everything ran smoothly and to say thank you and Merry Christmas. He even gave me a bunch of flowers, which was a lovely touch.All correspondence with JNT was prompt and professional.
JNT where great from sales, administration and insulation then follow up.Easy to deal with great communication with custom, through to completion.A big thank you.
Good value,quality installation, very good customer liaison  tradespersons very tidy

It was easy dealing with Daniel (JNT in Gladstone), very quick with the quote and three sensible choices to pick from.Seamless process from picking date, install and invoicing.The solar install was for an investment property.

Laurie was very professional, polite, explained the whole process during the quoting process. The installation was smooth and professional, the team was punctual, explained everything, worked efficiently and I’m very impressed with their professionalism. Highly recommend them and the solars are working beautifully ever since.

The consulting sales rep, Laurie, was thorough and clearly communicated their whole process so expectations were set. He then followed up from our meeting promptly with competitive pricing.The install team showed up right on time, was polite/tidy, and gave me a thorough install debrief.So far, I've had a great customer service experience.

Many thanks to Laurie for the time spent explaining the system and the follow up after installation.The installers were on time, extremely polite, and left the place in a very clean tidy way.Many thanks also to the team for their work installing, and also to Lochie for coming over to the house after installation to install the grid connection and app on my phone.
As planned and why does the the review need to be more than 10 words

The whole process with JNT Electrical was excellent, the quoting process was easy and spent time explaining the process. The installation was on time and tidied up after themselves. Laurie turned up during the installation with flowers for my wife, a very nice touch. The system has been operating for a few weeks now and everything is working fine.
Very helpful sales, punctual, clean and pleasant installers.Great site Finn put us on the right road to understanding solar.

Very knowledgeable sales person and did not push us into buying a big system we didn't need. Met our requirements to a T. Installers were fast, knowledgeable and very polite. Would recommend to anyone.

Sales process was simple as I knew what system I wanted and just needed to confirm pricing and availability. Very quick to arrange the system and install. Very impressed with the install process and workmanship quality.  Connection was all arranged with Energy supplier. All in all, extremely happy with the service from start to finish. Added comfort of knowing there is local support should there be any issues later.

From the initial sales call to completion of the install the level of customer service was excellent information provided was clear, easy to understand and followed up om when required. The install was on time, efficient and proffesionaly carried out. The administration of the install was performed without a hitch, timing of different steps were communicated and proved to be spot on ( including connection to grid).Overall a good experience.

The quoting process went very smoothly, even though I made a few changes.The installers arrived when they said they would, did a good job and even cleaned up after them selves.Great customer service and overall a very good experience.
From the start the company made me feel as if I matter. They were professional and courteous, and everything was done on time.
The whole process with JNT was seamless. Very clean tradesmen

The guys that carried out the install were very professional. The equipment installed was all to a very high standard and also cleaned up the mess once complete. I had a couple of minor issues with the smart meter and these were addressed promptly by Jason who turned up when he said he would. Canâ€™t fault these guys and would highly recommend them to anyone wanting a solar PV system on the Gold Coast.SteveBroadbeach Waters
Process made easy by the JNT team. Simply a good local business.

A great experience- knowledgeable salesperson- no pressure!!!!!! Followed up and kept me informed throughout the process.Fantastic installation team- on time - friendly, helpful and professional - great attention to detail onsite.
Great install.Did not receive any help with the App for the inverter which was not easy to connect with.But all other aspects of the install were great

Great professional service all the way through. A pleasure to deal with, and made the transition to solar very easy. Sales process was relaxed and unpressed.Laurie and Jason made everything very clear. Installers were slick and efficient. No broken tiles! Good communication and follow up. Happy to recommend.

Went to grid today so will be waiting to see resultsSales and a genuine quote - excellent. Dan gave me all details and quote that was for install not an inflated one that covers deals with finance companies, which saved lots compared to â€œinterest freeâ€ installers, watch out for this, offer cash and price drops drastically. Appreciated the honest upfront approach from DanGreat install. Came out yesterday and scoped job (raining) turned up as scheduled today and gone by smoko leaving behind a very happy customer. Been in electrical install game for 50 years and would have these boys on my team anytime. Well done looks goodNow I can see why JNT was recommended.

After doing lots of research on the best inverter / solar panels and getting many quotes I finally decided upon getting JNT Electrical to do the install. For was for a number of reasons, they offered the best price, best (timely) customer service & agreed to do the job 3 months down the track (at my request) with no deposit required.  Laurie, their Sales Rep is fantastic! Laurie ended up doing 3 different quotes for me (at my request) as I kept changing my mind (re panels/inverter & the number of panels I wanted). None of this was ever a problem for Laurie. He'd get the quote back to me later the same day or following morning. JNT organised all the change over paperwork for me, I didn't have to do anything with my energy provider or Energex in connecting to the grid, JNT did it all. Lachie (their wonderful technician/installer) even got up on the roof to do a precise measure up included in their quote (not many other techs who came out did this - go the same effort or time). Jason the owner of JNT was so helpful, friendly & professional. Nothing was too much trouble for him either. Jason & his team of four (4) showed up on time on the day of install, finished in a matter of hours, their team is efficient and hard working. Laurie the Sales Rep even showed up on the day to hand deliver me a bouquet of flowers to thank me for choosing JNT. By choosing JNT I ended up saving up to $1500 compared to other solar installers on the GC (for the same premium product). JNT are the best value for money on the Gold Coast. If you're looking to get solar quotes, start with JNT Electrical. I guarantee you'll get the best price (comparing apples for apples - premium inverter/panel products), the best service & peace of mind with their professionalism & any follow up questions you might have after installation. I can't fault these guys. Very happy I chose JNT.

Sales and quoting.....no nonsense.  Told you what you needed to know and factored in a roof restoration for us with the ability to stage the installation of brackets and return to install the rest of the system when our roof was sealed.The guys were polite, punctual, tidy and good tradies.The after sales service has been fantastic with all warranty, STC and registration docs emailed through.The only thing I could fault was my choice of system components and even then, I have no issue.A pleasure to deal with.
Jason and his colleague arrived on time. The panels were installed quickly and efficiently and it was explained clearly.
The boys from JNT Electrical did a great job. Nothing was a problem, everything was explained to us about the system and the job was left spotless. I would highly recommend them.

Laurie visited my property and provided a verbal quote while at my property. This was confirmed in writing same day.Contract was discussed and no deposit required as early installation was agreed.Jason, company owner, installed 6.6Kw system (5Kw inverter with 20x330Kw panels) on the agreed day in around 5 hours and I was impressed with Jasonâ€™s friendly while professional approach. Grid connection was arranged prior to installation as my existing system was being replaced.Very pleased with process from start to finish. Iâ€™d recommend JNT to anyone considering solar.
Could not recommend more highly.Extremely professional and went the extra mile.Very punctual and explained to me every aspect.

The sales process was painless and informative.The installation was carried out within 3 weeks of quote acceptance.The team of installers were polite , effective to and informative . We were amazed at how quickly the job was completed.  The sales person arrived, during the installation, with a bunch of flowers. Nice touch.The grid connection was organised by JNT.

JNT proved to be a very good choice. They were very congenial while being 'upfront'. They provided thorough consultation and faultless administration and delivery. All this plus a personal touch. Most satisfied customers David and Sofahnya

Price was an important factor in my choice as was service. In this instance with JNT, I had both and more. Although my solar system is yet to be commissioned , I had a couple of hiccups post installation occurring in the meter box. JNT were all over it providing exceptional and prompt attention ensuring the least amount of inconvenience even attending out of hours to remedy the problem. I will go as far as to say I have never received this quality of service from any other trade like I have with JNT. A young company with a young owner that is certainly going places. JNT provide the service that you should but don't receive from many other trades. Jason (owner) for his age (young), has acquired outstanding ethics combined with a passion and commitment in service that will ensure he will be around for a long time into the future. A Very Happy Customer.
the process of sales was professional, clear and no sales pressure.installation was done tidy and functional. the process was explained.i was very happy with the whole deal and installation

The quote was offered and then executed in an efficient manner. The installation was very punctual and only took a few hours. The grid connection is pending but I understand JNT have set the wheels in motion for this.
Turned up on time, and did a great job.  JNT Electrical were courteous, provided value for money, and answered all my questions. They were GREAT!
Great to deal with and it all went very smoothly
Excellent service and able to install second system in Brisbane in early January.
Very neat and tidy team and very polite and gave me a quality system at a very good price highly recommended

Thank you so much Jason for installing our solar panels and battery system. We have gone from having high power bills to getting credits back from the supplier. I would recommend this company to anyone.
No unnecessary sales fluff or high pressure tactics, just a great product at a great price.
Laurie the sales guy was fantastic. He explained everything well and a nice guy.The installation was quick and I feel they really were the best choice for us. Very happy with the service.

Price was reasonable. The work was carried out when they said they would do it and the system is working far better than I thought it would.JNT Electrical are a very professional organization, from start to finish!

This supplier didn't try to value add and was transparent about battery cost effectiveness. Was flexible with their approach and enthusiastic about obtaining our business, which some of the others weren't.
It has been first class from start to finish.

Right from the initial consultation to the installation, we received excellent service. They were very understanding of our needs and quoted on what we required with no fuss. Laurie is one of the friendliest and non-pressuring salesmen that I have ever encountered. He was a delight to work with in getting our system. Jason was great in following up and checking that all was correct and as we liked it prior to the installation. The installation went smoothly and they system was up and running in a day. Very well done to all. Very please with the level of service. Many thanks to JNT Electrical.
Could not have been better.

Jason and his team are very professional, timely and clean up as they install. I emailed Laurie on Sunday and around one hour later I received a personal call by Jason to explain the issue. Amazing service and follow up support. Please contact Laurie or Jason to discuss the best system for your needs. Most importantly they are there to provide assistance after installation.

JNT set themselves apart from others by making a genuine effort to understand how we use our daily energy, and also catering to the questions we asked by presenting alternate solutions that may have been a little more tailored. Fantastic experience start to finish.
Thankyou very much for your website and advice. It helped me choose a system and installer. Iâ€™ve already recommended to a friend who just bought a 13kw system.

They were honest and told me the differences in systems and why thereâ€™s was cheaper. They also installed it within 4 days of me taking up the quote. Just waiting on my first power bill and seeing the results.

From start to finish this company was very professional. Initially they were very prompt at responding to our query and then we were given good sound advice about which system would be best for our circumstances. Installation was booked easily, and on the day they arrived early and had the job done with no fuss. The tradesman were very friendly and polite and clearly are very experienced as the installation went very smoothly. They cleaned up after themselves very well and before leaving gave us a detailed lesson in how to monitor the inverter and understand the data that the unit provides. We cannot speak highly enough of this company and we highly recommend JNT Electrical to anyone considering installing solar panels.
Installed in a morning, running by afternoon. Now awaiting change of meter.

Solar can be confusing , with quotes ranging all over the place for Chinese or European systems. I just decided to go with JNT because they are a small local company and Laurie was pretty straight up when it came to what we needed.So far the system is exceeding what they said it would. I guess the value will be in the longevity of the system but so far its delivering. Very happy with JNT and the system they installed.Check out JNT facebook page for reviews,

I requested 2/3 panels on one side and 1/3 on other side of roof to produce even load throughout the day, and 3 hours later when I returned they had installed all on one side. with the comment "we can fit them all on this side so we don't need to use the other side of the roof. This side will get you the most generation"They took some initiative but did not give the customer what they asked for.
Would recommend JNT electrical. They were great with communication, knowledge and price. Very professional and polite. Pleasure doing business with them.

Finn, Information you supplied invaluable! Choice of installer due to price, installation before Xmas, easy to talk to, NOT at all pushy, Local, and most important I spoke to some one who had used their services. Lots of cow boys out there!!!!
